redate.observation: Re-read 2026-10-15, still open on its row: grep log deploy/caddy/Caddyfile finds no log directive; no Caddy access log exists (Tier-2 deploy change).

what: UI-UPGRADE-1-AUTH: confirm the non-browser /api/bot/* consumer inventory (design 2b, 33 groups / 42+ files, STATIC grep only) against 24 h of real traffic BEFORE SITE_AUTH_ENFORCE is flipped. MEASURED 2026-10-11 from deploy/caddy/Caddyfile: Caddy has NO access-log directive, so there is currently no Caddy access log to read (the design's '24 h of the Caddy access log' was an assumption); uvicorn's access lines go to the journal, whose retention another row of this repo measures at ~30 minutes. So step one is a Tier-2 Caddyfile change (add a `log` block writing JSON to a file, request line + status + remote_ip + User-Agent only, never the Authorization header) deployed via vm-caddy-deploy, THEN 24 h of traffic, THEN group the requests by (User-Agent, remote_ip, path) and diff against the inventory: any caller not in the inventory is a missed consumer.
